That is why 👂 travels especially well on story replies, DM reactions, and any context where the sender wants the message to land with ear energy in a single tap.

longForm.whenNotToUse:
Skip 👂 in condolence, sympathy, or break-up contexts — the ear cue is too lightweight for somber moments. A quiet ❤️ or a plain sentence that acknowledges the feeling is a better fit.

Avoid 👂 when the message calls for literal precision. If the sender needs an exact ear reference (a recipe, an instruction, a specific product), use a word or a more specific emoji rather than the ear shorthand.

Skip 👂 in very formal channels — legal emails, executive memos, regulated finance or healthcare messages. The ear cue reads as casual and can undercut professional weight. Stick to plain text where tone matters.
